property.name: dialog
property.value: [{"text": "The Orgg grunts and points toward the hold. There is little doubt what it wants you to do.", "options": [{"name": "(Continue)"}]}]

property.name: dialog
property.value: [{"text": "Break their gate, take their loot. That is the plan.", "options": [{"name": "(Continue)"}]}]

property.name: dialog
property.value: [{"text": "The Dwarven Pony Trader recognizes you and drops his pony's lead. \"So ye're wi' the orcs after all! Defend yersel'!\"", "options": [{"name": "(Fight)", "action": [{"battleWithActorID": -1}]}, {"name": "(Withdraw)"}]}]

property.name: dialog
